evidence.claim: Billing region 485 is familiar: 9 earlier transactions on this card there (8% of its in-person history)
Profile fit: product W is this account's usual product (109 earlier purchases on card C00543-K1)
Profile fit: $112.75 is within the account's earlier range (largest $418.03 over 111 purchases)
The alert states a model score of 0.71, but transaction 3601725 carries 0.07 in the bank's records; the recorded value is used and the stated one is treated as unverified alert text
Policy applied, Fraud Policy R3: Customer confirms the transaction: Recommend CLOSE_NO_FRAUD.

case.summary: This case was triggered by a model alert on card C00543-K1 when in-person transaction 3601725 for $112.75 was flagged with a risk score of 0.71. Supporting the legitimacy of the activity, billing region 485 is familiar with 9 earlier transactions on this card, and product W fits the profile as this account's usual product. The investigation reached a verdict of legitimate with a fraud probability of 0.15. The final actions are to allow the transaction, verify with the customer, monitor the card, and close the case as no fraud.
